verdict.rationale: Kick has built-in AI agents that work on their own: AI categorization handles about 97% of transactions, with confidence gating, and automated categorization and transfer matching are logged under a 'Kick agent'. However, open-ended natural-language delegation (look things up, make changes, run reports) runs only through external assistants connected via MCP/CLI or Google Sheets, not through an assistant inside Kick itself. Missing for 10: a documented in-product conversational assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to, delegation beyond categorization and matching without external tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
